<!--
  The proof of CtaProof. Shapes: logos (six names with a glyph), features (small features in two columns), stats
  (three figures), rows (four icon rows), zones (delivery zones: name and areas, price and time).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CtaContent } from "../blocks/cta-proof.types";

  export type CtaProofItemsProps = {
    content: CtaContent;
    proof?: "logos" | "features" | "stats" | "rows" | "zones";
    center?: boolean;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

  let { content, proof = "stats", center = false }: CtaProofItemsProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((proof as string) === "logos")}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6" data-testid="cta-proof">
    {#each content.logos as l (l.id)}
      <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="center" class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="cta-item">
        <LucideIcon name={l.icon} size={20} />
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {l.name}
        </Text>
      </Group>
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if ((proof as string) === "features")}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 text-left sm:grid-cols-2" data-testid="cta-proof">
    {#each content.features as f (f.id)}
      <Group gap="4" align="start" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="cta-item">
        <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
          <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={20} />
        </Box>
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {f.title}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {f.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if ((proof as string) === "stats")}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="cta-proof">
    {#each content.stats as s, i (s.id)}
      {#if (i < 3)}
        <Stack gap="0" class={(center ? "items-center text-center" : "")} data-testid="cta-item">
          <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
            {s.value}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {s.label}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if ((proof as string) === "rows")}
  <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0" data-testid="cta-proof">
    {#each content.features as f (f.id)}
      <ListItem class="flex items-start gap-4" data-testid="cta-item">
        <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
          <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={20} />
        </Box>
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {f.title}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {f.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
{/if}
{#if ((proof as string) === "zones")}
  <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col p-0" data-testid="cta-proof">
    {#each content.zones as z (z.id)}
      <ListItem class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-4" data-testid="cta-item">
        <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {z.name}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {z.area}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Stack gap="0" class="shrink-0 text-right">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {fmtMoney(z.price, z.currency)}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {z.time}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
{/if}
